done_when: forge test --pytest also selects every test file that names a changed file's path (for example docs/commands.md, the shipped guide, a workflow file), besides tests that import changed code; a command test shows a docs-only change selecting the test that reads that doc; new client repos get it from init and existing ones from upgrade, with a command test for each
why: The quick test run skips tests that read changed docs, guides or workflows, so CI goes red on them after every such change
